plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official 2025-2026 Arkansas Tech University Catalog, 'Music Arts, Bachelor of Music Arts' curriculum (pp. 183-186), a genuine institution-published semester sequence. To meet the requirements for the baccalaureate degree in music arts, the student must complete 120 semester hours, including: 12 hours of applied music and successful completion of the Applied Competency and Keyboard Proficiency Exams; 6 hours in major ensembles (band or choir); 16 hours in music theory and ear training; and 9 hours of music history. An audition, demonstrating acceptable musical preparation, is required prior to enrollment as a major in music. All music majors must demonstrate acceptable piano proficiency or enroll in class or applied piano each semester until successful completion of the appropriate Keyboard Proficiency Exit Exam; all music majors are required to attend a prescribed number of campus concerts and recitals (successful completion of 6 semesters of recital attendance is required). Private instruction in the student's major performance area is required of all music majors: one one-hour lesson and 12 hours of practice per week, carrying two semester hours of credit. Catalog footnote 1: see appropriate alternatives or substitutions in General Education Requirements (p. 75). Catalog footnote 2: see course descriptions for the appropriate applied music course number (the 'MUS_1__2' / 'MUS_3__2' slots below are applied music, 2 hours per catalog). Catalog footnote 3: class piano or applied piano must be taken each semester until successful completion of Piano Proficiency. Catalog footnote 4: Applied Competency is required for enrollment in upper-level applied study for two-hour credit and for completion of all music degrees. Catalog footnote 5: concurrent enrollment in a major ensemble (MUS 1501 Band, MUS 1631 Symphonic Wind Ensemble, MUS 1571 University Choir, MUS 1581 Choral Artists, MUS 1681 Concert Chorale, MUS 3501 Band, MUS 3631 Symphonic Wind Ensemble, MUS 3571 University Choir, MUS 3581 Choral Artists, or MUS 3681 Concert Chorale) is required to be eligible to enroll in applied study; only one credit per semester may be used to fulfill the major ensemble requirement — the select-one major-ensemble slot per term is seeded as a single choice slot per catalog. Zero-credit items (MUS 1000/MUS 3000 Recital Attendance, MUS 1440 Piano Proficiency, MUS 2000 Applied Competency) are required degree milestones and carry required_zero:true. Machine prereqs omitted (prereq: []) — the curriculum page prints no per-course prerequisites. tccns mirrors the local ATU course code; transfer_confidence core_only. Coordinator note (2026-10-01): allow_repeated_courses=true. The catalog genuinely requires the same courses in multiple semesters: MUS 1000/MUS 3000 Recital Attendance (0-credit, required each semester), a major ensemble each semester (footnote 9: only one ensemble credit per semester may count; select-one slots seeded as single choice slots with the catalog's slash notation, verbatim course codes preserved in options), and applied-music study each semester (MUS 1202 Piano / MUS 1232 Voice / MUS 1501 Band as applicable; instrument-specific numbers per catalog footnote 2). These are true repeats of the same requirement, not transcription errors.
